statement:
∀ (θ φ : ℝ),
  ↑(sin θ ^ 2 * cos (2 * φ)) =
    ↑√(8 * π / 15) *
      (↑√(15 / (32 * π)) * ↑(sin θ) ^ 2 * Complex.exp (2 * ↑φ * Complex.I) +
        ↑√(15 / (32 * π)) * ↑(sin θ) ^ 2 * Complex.exp (-(2 * ↑φ) * Complex.I))

goal.text:
↑(sin θ ^ 2 * cos (2 * φ)) =
  ↑√(8 * π / 15) *
    (↑√(15 / (32 * π)) * ↑(sin θ) ^ 2 * Complex.exp (2 * ↑φ * Complex.I) +
      ↑√(15 / (32 * π)) * ↑(sin θ) ^ 2 * Complex.exp (-(2 * ↑φ) * Complex.I))
goal.rhs:
↑√(8 * π / 15) *
  (↑√(15 / (32 * π)) * ↑(sin θ) ^ 2 * Complex.exp (2 * ↑φ * Complex.I) +
